title: Temporal Validity with Revocation Overrides
description: Demonstrates composing an issuance window claim with a revocation-status claim. The pattern shows that a credential is valid only if (a) its notBefore <= now < its expirationDate AND (b) no revocation entry exists after its issuance. Useful for offline-first verifiers that receive policy bundles out of order and must resolve temporal and revocation precedence deterministically.
